2608.30952.title: One Policy Is Enough: Single-Agent Reinforcement Learning Outperforms Tree Search for Chemistry Tool Learning
2608.30952.paper_summary: Chemistry questions often demand exact computation and database lookups that a language model cannot supply from its parameters, so it must reach for external tools. Tool use here is a three-part problem: select the right tool from a large pool, fill it with correctly typed arguments, and chain calls so that each consumes the outputs of the last. CheMatAgent, a previously published system, addresses this with hierarchical evolutionary MCTS: separate policy and execution models searching tool-call trees under two learned critics, one regressed partly onto GPT-assigned scores. We show that a single policy suffices. Our model interleaves reasoning, tool calls, and returns in one left-to-right generation, trained by a supervised warm-up and then outcome-level reinforcement learning against a programmatic reward read directly off the gold call chain, which leaves no learned critic and no judge in the training loop. On ChemToolBench multiple-tool comprehensive chemistry, on both backbones CheMatAgent use, we improve Tool F1 by 5.5% and Return F1 by 9.6% on Qwen-2.5-7B, and by 3.7% and 3.9% on Llama-3.1-8B, compared with their strongest search configuration, at one model invocation per question, against a search whose cost grows with the tree; we also lead answer Pass Rate on Qwen-2.5-7B.
2608.30952.paper_summary_zh: 化學問題通常需要精確的計算和資料庫查詢，而語言模型無法從其參數中提供這些，因此必須尋求外部工具。這裡的工具使用是一個三部分的問題：從大量工具中選擇合適的工具，填入正確類型的參數，並鏈接調用，以便每個調用消耗上一個的輸出。CheMatAgent，一個先前發表的系統，通過分層進化的MCTS來解決這個問題：分開的策略和執行模型在兩個學習的評估者下搜索工具調用樹，其中一個部分回歸於GPT分配的分數。我們展示了單一策略的足夠性。我們的模型在一次從左到右的生成中交錯推理、工具調用和返回，通過監督性熱身訓練，然後在程序化獎勵下進行結果級別的強化學習，該獎勵直接從金色調用鏈中讀取，這樣在訓練循環中沒有學習的評估者和判斷者。在ChemToolBench的多工具綜合化學上，無論是CheMatAgent的使用，對於Qwen-2.5-7B，我們將工具F1提高了5.5%，返回F1提高了9.6%；對於Llama-3.1-8B，分別提高了3.7%和3.9%，與其最強的搜索配置相比，每個問題進行一次模型調用，對抗一個隨著樹的增長而成本上升的搜索；我們在Qwen-2.5-7B上也領先了答案通過率。
